en: Color lithographed postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilly town with a prominent church on a ridge, identified in the caption as Schneeberg in the Ore Mountains. The central landscape is framed by a decorative border with leaves and berries. On the left foreground is a miner or worker leaning against a structure, holding a tool or lamp; on the right is a woman seated and making bobbin lace. The bottom contains printed German text naming the place and viewpoint.
